nodes.description: baseURI string used as the metadata base for tokenURI; writable by owner via setBaseURI.
baseExtension string ('.json') appended to token metadata; writable by owner.
discountSupply = 4; thresholds the free/cheap mint window in mint().
costDiscount = 0 ether; required msg.value for mints inside the discount window.
costNormal = 0.02 ether; required msg.value for regular mints; mutable via setCost().
maxSupply = 4269; hard cap enforced against totalSupply() in mint().
paused flag (default false) gating mint(); toggled by owner via pause().
BeanieGivesBack constructor: initializes ERC721 name/symbol and calls setBaseURI().
_baseURI() internal view override returning the baseURI state variable.
mint() public payable: supply checks, payment checks, pseudo-random gift recipient selection, _safeMint and ETH payout to the selected address.
walletOfOwner(address) view: enumerates token ids owned by an address.
randomNum(uint256 _mod, uint256 _seed, uint256 _salt) view: pseudo-random modulus over keccak256 of block.timestamp, msg.sender and caller-supplied inputs.
tokenURI(uint256) view override concatenating baseURI, token id and baseExtension.
setCost(uint256) onlyOwner: updates costNormal.
setBaseURI(string) onlyOwner: updates baseURI.
setBaseExtension(string) onlyOwner: updates baseExtension.
pause(bool) onlyOwner: toggles the paused state variable.
withdraw() public payable onlyOwner: forwards the full contract balance to msg.sender via low-level call.
msg.sender: caller-controlled address used as mint recipient, randomness seed and withdraw recipient.
block.timestamp: miner-influenced value used as the randomness seed in randomNum().
Low-level external call payable(giftAddress).call{value: giftValue}('') in mint() executed BEFORE state finalization of the payout, transferring ETH to a pseudo-randomly chosen address.
Low-level external call payable(msg.sender).call{value: address(this).balance}('') in withdraw().
Arithmetic on user/state derived values: supply + 1, address(this).balance * 10 / 100, msg.value * 10 / 100 and msg.value >= costNormal comparisons.
Predictable pseudo-randomness derived from block.timestamp, msg.sender and caller-supplied seed/salt, used to pick the gift recipient.
_safeMint() triggers the IERC721Receiver.onERC721Received callback on the recipient contract before the ETH payout completes, giving an attacker-controlled contract control flow inside mint().
constructor parameter _initBaseURI (string).
setCost parameter _newCost (uint256).
setBaseURI parameter _newBaseURI (string).
setBaseExtension parameter _newBaseExtension (string).
pause parameter _state (bool).
randomNum parameter _mod (uint256 modulus).
randomNum parameter _seed (uint256).
randomNum parameter _salt (uint256).
walletOfOwner parameter _owner (address).
tokenURI parameter tokenId (uint256).
mint() local supply = totalSupply(), used for cap checks and gift math.
mint() local giftAddress, payable target of the ETH payout (msg.sender or a pseudo-random owner).
mint() local giftValue, 10% of msg.value or 10% of contract balance on final mint.
mint() local success flag returned by the low-level gift payout call.
withdraw() local s flag returned by the low-level balance transfer call.

edges.reason: _baseURI() reads the baseURI state variable.
tokenURI() concatenates baseURI into the returned metadata URI.
setBaseURI() writes the baseURI state variable.
tokenURI() appends baseExtension to the metadata URI.
setBaseExtension() writes the baseExtension state variable.
mint() compares totalSupply against discountSupply to decide the price.
mint() requires msg.value >= costDiscount inside the discount window.
mint() requires msg.value >= costNormal for regular mints.
setCost() writes the costNormal state variable.
mint() enforces supply + 1 <= maxSupply.
mint() requires !paused.
pause() writes the paused state variable.
msg.sender controls the mint recipient and the giftAddress fallback.
msg.sender is part of the keccak256 randomness seed in randomNum().
msg.sender is the recipient of the full-balance low-level call in withdraw(), enabling a reentrant caller.
block.timestamp is used as the randomness seed, making the outcome miner-influenceable (timestamp dependency).
block.timestamp feeds the pseudo-random gift recipient selection (timestamp dependency).
Constructor parameter _initBaseURI is forwarded to setBaseURI().
setCost parameter _newCost is written into costNormal.
setBaseURI parameter _newBaseURI is written into baseURI.
setBaseExtension parameter _newBaseExtension is written into baseExtension.
pause parameter _state is written into the paused flag.
_mod is the modulus applied to the random number.
_seed is packed into the randomness hash.
_salt is packed into the randomness hash.
_owner selects the address whose token ids are enumerated.
tokenId is existence-checked and appended to the metadata URI.
supply + 1 feeds the arithmetic used for cap checks and gift size.
supply determines whether giftValue is msg.value*10/100 or balance*10/100.
giftAddress (attacker-influenced owner or msg.sender) is the target of the low-level value call.
giftValue is the ETH amount forwarded in the low-level gift call.
mint() performs the external value transfer to giftAddress before the transaction completes.
mint() computes supply + 1, msg.value * 10 / 100 and balance * 10 / 100.
withdraw() forwards the whole contract balance through a low-level call.
mint() calls _safeMint, which invokes the receiver callback on contract recipients.
Constructor invokes setBaseURI().
tokenURI() calls _baseURI().
mint() calls randomNum() to select the gift recipient.
The gift recipient (a contract) can re-enter mint() while the value call is in flight, re-minting and re-triggering the gift payout.
msg.sender receiving the full balance can re-enter withdraw() because the call forwards all gas and the balance is not zeroed first.
The ERC721 receiver hook re-enters mint() (before the gift payout) allowing repeated mints within one transaction.
